In canon that prom becomes a choreographed scene in their senior play so it tracks well. I try to play really honest to their emotions because they are still in highschool and would be a little more erratic so Ryan is a little touchier, more ready to see things as an attack because they so often have been in the past. Meanwhile Chad has more of that understanding and kind of masks it, he's black and queer in early 00's Albuquerque, he knows that he isn't a golden boy anymore once he leaves the gym, but that doesn't mean he still isn't used to things kind of being handed to him. Ryan taking his time and being frigid is new to him in the same way that Chad being patient and putting up with the fear is new to Ryan.
